title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20

ai_review.summary: Clean soundboard capture of a classic ’82 show with a smoking Scarlet > Fire transition and jammy Terrapin Station.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard quality, though one reviewer notes it runs slightly fast and the bass balance is a bit recessed. Musically the performance is high‑energy – Jerry’s guitar work is “tremendous,” Brent’s keyboards lock in perfectly, and the nearly 12‑minute Scarlet > Fire stretch along with a jam‑filled Terrapin Station are highlighted as show‑stopper moments.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers are enthusiastic (average 4.3★). Show quality is consistently described as classic and high‑energy, while recording quality is noted as clean with only minor speed/balance quirks, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very clean and crisp soundboard capture; slight tape‑speed issue makes the mix feel a half‑step fast and bass (Phil) sits a bit back, but overall balance is solid.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows strongly with a jam‑heavy Terrapin and an extended, deliberate Scarlet > Fire transition that showcases tight interplay.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar work described as “tremendous” with killer licks; Jerry is clearly digging the music.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is noted as being pushed to the background and slightly affected by the fast tape speed.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboards are praised for being perfectly matched and integral to the transition.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drumming described as subtle yet deliberate, supporting the long Scarlet jam.
